theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, List.mem_append]
  fun_induction substOld
  case case7 => exact Or.inr
  any_goals with_reducible exact Or.inl
  all_goals simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append]
  all_goals with_reducible repeat first | assumption | apply or_or_distrib_right.mpr.comp; apply Or.imp

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f f' cs P' y
  have : P' = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs + Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    simp only [P', cs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hq k := Subtype.mk.inj
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.2 _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap ..))
  simp only [f', f, fold, P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
    ↓Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, ↓←hq, this, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.2, Fin2ToF2,
    one_ne_zero, reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
    Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis, add_zero, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  ring1

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard) '' Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  dsimp only at hg
  have hb := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)))
  simp only [fiberwiseDistance, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.sub_add_comm (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at hb
  rw [← hg, mul_assoc] at hb
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.1 g.2) bot_le).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ?_).trans_lt hb))
  conv_rhs => rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']; rhs; rw [← Fintype.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ← Finset.card_univ]
  rw [← Finset.card_product]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber _ _ _ _ (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point _ _ i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  any_goals solve_by_elim
  case' app l _ _ _ => have := l.canonical_form_abs
  case' tapp d _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_tabs
  case' case d _ _ _ _ _ => have := d.canonical_form_sum
  all_goals repeat' first | simp_all only [body_let, body_case, true_implies] | casesm* _ ∧ _, _ ∨ _, Exists _, Value (.inl _), Value (.inr _) | cases lc
  any_goals left; solve_by_elim
  all_goals right; solve_by_elim only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)

  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard) '' Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  dsimp only at hg
  have hb := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)))
  simp only [fiberwiseDistance, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.sub_add_comm (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at hb
  rw [← hg, mul_assoc] at hb
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.1 g.2) bot_le).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ?_).trans_lt hb))
  conv_rhs => rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']; rhs; rw [← Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.card_product]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber _ _ _ _ (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point _ _ i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := (Set.Finite.pi fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (by exact fun n k hk => hB (n+k))
  have key m : u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    clear hij
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on
    rename_i m ih
    by_cases hm : 4 ≤ m
    · apply @Int.cast_injective ℝ
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
    · exact congrFun h ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hm⟩
  use i, j-i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij
  intro n hn
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn, key, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hij.le]
